answers.ask: Does the player drive the CC201, ride it, or watch it run - and is there anything to complete, or is it free-roam?
answers.answer: The player drives the CC201 in free-roam, with no required objectives.

answers.ask: How long should the line run end to end? 'Huge' could mean a few thousand studs or an entire province.
answers.answer: Make it a large but practical map with roughly 10,000 studs of railway end to end.

answers.ask: Is the railway a single point-to-point line, or a loop so the train can run continuously?
answers.answer: Use a single point-to-point railway line.

scene_prompt: Create a realistic Indonesian railway map with a single point-to-point rail line running roughly 10,000 studs end to end. Place the CC201 locomotive on the route, with roads alongside portions of the track, roadside power lines, level crossings, and moving cars on the adjacent roads. Arrange the large map as a continuous rail corridor with varied surrounding terrain and settlements along the line.
agent_notes: Driving the CC201 free-roam with no objectives is Simulation, not Racing, since there is no lap and no finish. Vessel Operation was the closest preset and it is the one modelled on Roblox train places, but its vehicle-deck shape claims the world moves past a walkable deck, and here the player drives roughly 10,000 studs of line through the landscape, and its trigger-task loop was explicitly declined, so with the shape swapped and most options gone I emit no preset rather than a preset that is no longer recognisable. I took route-guided from the catalogue rather than Simulation's typical list: it is one continuous space with a single directed route, which is the answered single point-to-point line, and it routes P0; route-point-to-point was rejected because it is a course with a finish and this has none, and world-open was rejected because the answer chose a line over a roamable field. path-circulation carries the railway corridor with its crossings, path-road-vehicle the roadside road the power lines follow, and npc-population is bent to the moving AI traffic, which has no other home. Decided without a user: free-roam means nothing terminal is placed at either end of the line, and with no station interiors asked for there is no P3.
